python3 -c "
from pypdf import PdfReader
r = PdfReader('report.pdf')
print('Total pages:', len(r.pages))
for i, page in enumerate(r.pages):
    mb = page.mediabox
    print(f'--- Page {i+1} ({mb.width:.0f}x{mb.height:.0f} pts) ---')
    text = page.extract_text() or ''
    print(text.strip()[:400])
    print()
